moves.label: Trade: James Wiseman, Saddiq Bey, Kevin Knox II, Saddiq Bey, Gary Payton II and others
moves.description: James Wiseman was acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Saddiq Bey and Kevin Knox II. Saddiq Bey was acquired by the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for a conditional 2025 2nd round pick (ATL own), a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a conditional 2024 2nd round pick (ATL own), a 2026 2nd round pick (ATL own), a 2028 2nd round pick (ATL own) and a TPE. Gary Payton II, a 2026 2nd round pick (ATL own), a 2028 2nd round pick (ATL own) and a TPE were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for James Wiseman, a conditional 2026 2nd round pick (MEM own) and a 2028 2nd round pick (GOS own). Kevin Knox II, a conditional 2025 2nd round pick (ATL own), a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a conditional 2024 2nd round pick (ATL own), a conditional 2026 2nd round pick (MEM own), a 2028 2nd round pick (GOS own) and a TPE were acquired by the Portland Trail Blazers in exchange for Gary Payton II and a TPE.

moves.description: A 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own) was acquired by the Philadelphia Sixers in exchange for Buddy Hield. Klay Thompson and a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick were acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for Josh Green and a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own). Kyle Anderson and Buddy Hield were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for Klay Thompson, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks and cash. Josh Green, Reggie Jackson, a 2029 2nd round pick (DEN own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (DEN own) were acquired by the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for a 2025 2nd round pick (PHL own) and cash. A 2025 2nd round pick (PHL own), cash and a TPE were acquired by the Denver Nuggets in exchange for Reggie Jackson, a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (DEN own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (DEN own). A Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks, cash and a TPE were acquired by the Minnesota Timberwolves in exchange for Kyle Anderson.

P.J. Tucker, a 2026 2nd round pick (LAL own) and cash were acquired by the Toronto Raptors in exchange for Davion Mitchell. Kyle Anderson, Davion Mitchell, Andrew Wiggins, a conditional 2025 1st round pick (GOS own), a Swap 2031 2nd round picks and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Miami Heat in exchange for Jimmy Butler III, Josh Richardson, a 2026 2nd round pick (LAL own) and cash. Jimmy Butler III, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks, cash and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for Kyle Anderson, Dennis Schroder, Lindy Waters III, Andrew Wiggins and a conditional 2025 1st round pick (GOS own). K.J. Martin, Josh Richardson, a Least Favorable 2028 2nd round pick, cash and a TPE were acquired by the Utah Jazz in exchange for P.J. Tucker and a Swap 2031 2nd round picks.

moves.label: Trade: Adou Thiero, Adou Thiero, Rocco Zikarsky, Jahmai Mashack, Alex Toohey and others
moves.description: A 2030 2nd round pick (BOS own) was acquired by the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for the draft rights to Adou Thiero and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks. The draft rights to Adou Thiero was acquired by the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for the draft rights to Rocco Zikarsky and cash. The draft rights to Jahmai Mashack and the draft rights to Alex Toohey were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for the draft rights to Koby Brea. Clint Capela, Kevin Durant and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks were acquired by the Houston Rockets in exchange for Dillon Brooks, Jalen Green, the draft rights to Khaman Maluach, the draft rights to Jahmai Mashack, a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a 2030 2nd round pick (BOS own), a Swap 2031 2nd round picks, a 2032 2nd round pick (HOU own) and cash. A Swap 2031 2nd round picks, cash and a TPE were acquired by the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for Clint Capela. The draft rights to Rocco Zikarsky, a Least Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a More Favorable 2032 2nd round pick and cash were acquired by the Minnesota Timberwolves in exchange for the draft rights to Rasheer Fleming. Dillon Brooks, Jalen Green, the draft rights to Koby Brea, the draft rights to Rasheer Fleming, the draft rights to Khaman Maluach, a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick and a 2032 2nd round pick (HOU own) were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Kevin Durant, the draft rights to Alex Toohey, a Least Favorable 2026 2nd round pick and a More Favorable 2032 2nd round pick.

moves.label: Trade: Will Richard, Justinian Jessup, Jahmai Mashack
moves.description: The draft rights to Will Richard was acquired by the Golden State Warriors from the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for: the draft rights to Justinian Jessup, the draft rights to Jahmai Mashack and a conditional 2032 2nd round pick (GOS own).
